verification_log.method: Fetched and read the commentary on Haggai 1

Five dates (1:1, 1:15, 2:1, 2:10, 2:20); the first oracle "September, 520 B.C."; chronology: return 538, construction begun 536, stopped 534, resumed 520, finished four years later; "the time has not come" possibly tied to Jeremiah's seventy years (Ussher: the 69th year since the last siege); Haggai the first post-exilic prophet; drought and poor harvests as the covenant curse (Deut 11:16–17)
